description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ikiriwewa, Thabuttegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110052
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka), and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
